subject: SCIM provisioning runbook + SAML assertion samples for Clearshore SOC2
messages:
From: Mina Lopez <mina.lopez@clearshore.co>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: SCIM delta + role mapping for upcoming SOC2 review

Hi Laura,

Hope you9re well. We're preparing for our SOC2 fieldwork and the auditors have asked us to provide: a recent SCIM delta export for user provisioning (last 90 days), a human-readable mapping between Clearshore groups and Redwood roles, and a handful of SAML assertion samples for login events (to validate attributes and audience/issuer values).

Target deadline from the audit team is Jan 31. Can your team provide a sampling of these items and a short runbook that explains provisioning lifecycle (invites, group changes, deprovisioning) and where to find logs? We prefer CSV samples for the SCIM deltas and redacted assertion examples (remove PII).

Also note: auditors will ask about our approach to least-privilege role assignment and whether you have a documented rollback/playbook if SCIM provisioning misapplies roles.

Thanks,
Mina
Mina Lopez
Security & Compliance Manager
Clearshore Financial
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jan 2028 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + role mapping for upcoming SOC2 review

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the note and the timeline. Looping in Rishi (IAM / provisioning) and Marissa (customer security) to own the artifacts. High-level plan:
- We9ll produce a redacted SCIM delta CSV covering the last 90 days and include a short column-by-column README.
- We9ll attach three SAML assertion samples showing (1) login, (2) attribute-refresh, (3) session-continue, with PII redacted.
- We9ll draft a 2-page provisioning runbook that covers invite flows, group<>role mapping, deprovisioning, and the rollback steps you mentioned.

Quick questions:
1) For the SCIM sample, do you want all user attributes or a reduced set (id, userName, emails, groups, active, meta.lastModified)?
2) Are there specific user IDs or groups you want to include in the sample (we can limit to Clearshore-sourced users only)?
3) You referenced jurisdictional samples for EU logins—do you need an assertion example with eu-data-residency hints?

We can deliver a first bundle by EOD Mon Jan 24 if that works.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Lopez <mina.lopez@clearshore.co>

Date: Fri, 19 Jan 2028 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + role mapping for upcoming SOC2 review

Hi Mina,

Adding detail on the artifacts we9ll produce and a few controls notes:

Artifacts (attached as stubs in this thread):
- scim-delta-sample.csv (CSV): redacted rows showing create/update/delete ops from the last 90 days. Fields included: id, userName, displayName, emails[type], active, groups (comma-separated), meta.lastModified.
- saml-assertion-examples.txt (TXT): three examples with attributes redacted; audience/issuer and NameID preserved for verification.
- provisioning-runbook-v1.pdf (PDF): 2-pager runbook with step-by-step for invite->group-assign->deprovision + a rollback checklist.

Control notes:
- We will redact email local-parts and replace raw user IDs with pseudonyms (e.g., user_###) to avoid sending PII to auditors outside your approved scope.
- Group->role mapping is maintained in our internal config and exported as a human-readable CSV in the bundle.
- For sampling methodology we select the most recent create/update/delete events and include at least one case per operation type. If you need a deterministic mapping (every instance of role X), we can extend the sample but that will take extra time.

Question: For EU SAML samples, do you want an assertion generated via our EU-region IdP (if Clearshore has a EU tenant)? If yes, provide one EU test user so we can generate a live assertion rather than a synthetic one.

-Rishi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Lopez <mina.lopez@clearshore.co>

Thanks Rishi / Laura — this looks good.

Answers:
- For the SCIM sample please include the reduced set you suggested (id, userName, emails, groups, active, meta.lastModified).
- Limit the sample to Clearshore-scoped users; include one example where a contractor was deprovisioned (delete operation) and one where group membership changed.
- We do have a EU test account: eu_test_user@clearshore.co. If you can generate a real EU-region SAML assertion (redacted), that9d be ideal.

Workback: EOD Mon Jan 24 delivery is fine. Also please include a single-line summary in the runbook that states how least-privilege decisions are made and where to find the role-approval logs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — auditors will be reviewing the bundle that week.

Best,
Mina
